name: Stremio
summary: Press play and watch straight away, without waiting for a download or keeping the file.
after_install: Open it and it is empty on purpose — Stremio finds nothing by itself. Go to Addons, then Community Addons, and install Torrentio: that is the part that finds things to watch. Then search for a film, press play, and it starts in about half a minute. Nothing is kept afterwards; watch it twice and it is fetched twice. For anything you want to keep, use Jellyseerr instead.

storage.description: What Stremio is part-way through fetching, and its own settings. Bounded — it deletes the oldest to stay within a couple of gigabytes.

runs_as_root.reason: The entrypoint rewrites files in the image itself before starting, and nginx needs its own root-owned spool and log directories. Nothing in it drops privileges and it ignores PUID and PGID entirely, so starts_as_root would be a promise the image does not keep. Its only storage is private.
